caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, vertically oriented framed mirror design. The frame is golden with decorative beading along the vertical sides and a stepped cornice on top. The upper section of the frame contains a rectangular painted panel showing a sailing ship on blue waves, backed by a sky with clouds and brownish-black patches, and two black birds in flight; the panel is bordered by a marbled red and brown trim. Below this, a much larger glass or mirror surface is shown, depicted with gray and white crackle patterns simulating aged or weathered glass. On the right side are two technical line drawings: one is a side view of the top molding, and the other is a detailed cross-section of the construction of the top corner of the frame. The name "Roberta Elvis" is neatly written at the bottom, and a scale is indicated as ½ inch equals 1 foot. The background of the entire sheet is a plain off-white.
title: Mirror
